A2_construction.note: residual = observed loom+sound response probability minus the probability predicted by adding each giant fiber's measured sound-alone peak depolarisation to its loom-alone peak, per trial; percentile bootstrap resampling the loom-alone, loom+sound and sound-alone trials; peaks at different times over-predict summation, so the residual is biased low

loom_input.source: MEASURED (stationary trials, 13 series): Turner, Krieger, Pang & Clandinin 2022, eLife 11:e82587; Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.h44j0zpp8 (21 flies, extracted 2026-09-09)
